Cleanliness, efficiency and safety, held at fab speed
IAQ company profile
Semiconductor technology evolves at breakneck speed.

All three are settled at design stage, when the class, the airflow and the utility routes are fixed, rather than on site once the tools start arriving. A fab that reaches its class straight from the design holds its schedule.

One accountable team, every system

IAQ Group brings streamlined project management, modern construction methods and a dedicated team, so each client stays ahead.

We are a specialised engineering and construction company for semiconductor facilities, focused on cleanliness, efficiency and safety. The spaces we design and build are optimised for complex fabrication processes.

ISO 3 to ISO 7, proven by test

Delivered semiconductor projects run from ISO 3 to ISO 7, Class 1 to Class 10K. IAQ states it has built the highest standard of cleanroom, ISO Class 1, for a semiconductor project, and delivered it successfully. Classification is proven by test at commissioning, never assumed from the design.

HOW THE CLASS IS HELD

We test and commission to our established programme. It proves the facility operates as intended, at its best, and meets every specified requirement. Every element is verified and brought to specification, so the facility is fully functional before it is handed over for operation.
